title: Pure Mudragon
summary: The Mudragon strategy unites the two Extra Deck incarnations of Mudragon—Level 4 Fusion Mudragon of the Swamp and Level 6 Synchro Muddy Mudragon (which counts as a Fusion Substitute on the field AND Fusion Summons during your Main Phase without Polymerization!)—alongside King of the Swamp! Use Red Resonator or Assault Synchron to Synchro Summon Level 6 Muddy Mudragon, then activate Muddy Mudragon's Ignition Effect to fuse itself (substituting for any named Fusion Material!) with any Dragon or DARK/LIGHT monster on your field into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon, Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon, or Millennium-Eyes Restrict while Super Polymerization and Instant Fusion deploy Mudragon of the Swamp to make your entire board untargetable!

allow.Red Resonator: Level 2 FIRE Fiend Tuner that Special Summons a Level 4 monster from your hand on Normal Summon—immediately assembling Level 2 + Level 4 = Level 6 Synchro Muddy Mudragon!
allow.Assault Synchron: Level 2 DARK Machine Tuner that Special Summons itself from your hand for 700 LP; pairs with any Level 4 monster to immediately Synchro Summon Level 6 Muddy Mudragon without using your Normal Summon!
allow.Keeper of Dragon Magic: Level 4 DARK Dragon: discards 1 card on Summon to search Polymerization or Super Polymerization, and revives a named Fusion Material; pairs with Red Resonator/Assault Synchron for Muddy Mudragon, or fuses on field into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon!
allow.Fallen of Albaz: Level 4 DARK Dragon: fuses with an opponent's monster on Summon, OR stays on field so Muddy Mudragon can fuse itself (as Dark Magician) + Albaz into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon!
allow.Albion the Shrouded Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon that Special Summons itself from hand by sending Fallen of Albaz from Deck to GY, providing the Dragon Effect Monster on field so Muddy Mudragon can fuse into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon!
allow.Super Polymerization: Signature Quick-Play Spell for Mudragon of the Swamp: fuses any 2 monsters on the opponent's field with the same Attribute and different Types into Mudragon of the Swamp!
allow.Instant Fusion: Limited to 1 in TCG: pays 1000 LP to Special Summon Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp directly from the Extra Deck (making your monsters untargetable or pairing with a Level 2 Tuner for Level 6 Muddy Mudragon!).
allow.Polymerization: Searched by King of the Swamp and Keeper of Dragon Magic.
allow.Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon: Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Fusion: Fusion Summoned by Level 6 Synchro Muddy Mudragon's effect using Muddy Mudragon (substituting for Dark Magician) + any Dragon Effect Monster you control!
allow.Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon: Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion: Fusion Summoned by Muddy Mudragon's effect using Muddy Mudragon + any Dragon you control!
allow.Millennium-Eyes Restrict: Level 1 DARK Spellcaster Fusion: Fusion Summoned by Muddy Mudragon's effect using Muddy Mudragon + ANY Effect Monster you control, or via King of the Swamp + Polymerization!
allow.Lubellion the Searing Dragon: Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion summoned via Fallen of Albaz that shuffles King of the Swamp + a Dragon from your GY into the Deck to Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon!

main: King of the Swamp
The Main Deck form of Mudragon: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, OR discards itself from your hand to add 1 'Polymerization' from your Deck to your hand.
Beastking of the Swamps
Level 4 WATER Aqua Fusion Substitute monster that pairs with Level 2 Tuners for Level 6 Muddy Mudragon or substitutes for any named Fusion Material.
Red Resonator
Level 2 Tuner that Special Summons a Level 4 monster from your hand on Normal Summon (2 + 4 = Level 6 Muddy Mudragon!) and gains LP when Special Summoned.
Assault Synchron
Level 2 DARK Tuner that Special Summons itself from your hand without using your Normal Summon, tuning with any Level 4 into Level 6 Muddy Mudragon!
Keeper of Dragon Magic
Level 4 DARK Dragon: searches Polymerization or Super Polymerization on Summon, tunes with a Level 2 Tuner into Muddy Mudragon, OR fuses ON THE FIELD with Muddy Mudragon into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon!
Fallen of Albaz
Level 4 DARK Dragon: fuses with an opponent's monster into Lubellion or Mudragon of the Swamp, OR fuses on the field with Muddy Mudragon into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.
Albion the Shrouded Dragon
Level 8 DARK Dragon: sends Fallen of Albaz from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand—giving you the Dragon Effect Monster on field for Muddy Mudragon!
Super Polymerization
Unrespondable Quick-Play Spell that fuses 2 of your opponent's monsters into Mudragon of the Swamp.
Polymerization
Searched by King of the Swamp and Keeper of Dragon Magic to fuse King of the Swamp or Mudragon into Fusion bosses.
Instant Fusion

Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp from the Extra Deck—and tuning Level 2 Red Resonator/Assault Synchron + Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp Synchro Summons Level 6 Muddy Mudragon!
extra: Signature Level 4 WATER Wyrm Fusion boss (2 monsters with the same Attribute but different Types): your opponent cannot target this card, OR any monsters on the field with the same Attribute as this card, with card effects; Quick Effect once per turn to declare ANY Attribute and become that Attribute!

Signature Level 6 DARK Dragon Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners): can be used as a substitute for ANY 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster; during your Main Phase, Fusion Summons 1 Fusion Monster using monsters you control as material, including this card!
Summoned directly by Muddy Mudragon's effect using Muddy Mudragon (substituting for 'Dark Magician') + any Dragon Effect Monster on your field!
Summoned by Muddy Mudragon's effect using Muddy Mudragon (substituting for 'Blue-Eyes White Dragon') + any Dragon on your field.
Summoned by Muddy Mudragon's effect using Muddy Mudragon + any Effect Monster, or via Instant Fusion / King of the Swamp.
